prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D top-down sci-fi projectile material sheet for Geometry Survivor, not an illustration or UI mockup. True RGBA transparent background, no backdrop, no checkerboard pixels, no text, no labels, no frame. Square canvas divided into TWO spacious horizontal regions, no divider line. TOP region: one isolated compact projectile HEAD centred at (50% width,25% height), pointing horizontally RIGHT (+X); its solid compact head is centred exactly in that region, width about 34% canvas and height about 10%, symmetric about its horizontal axis. Orthographic, no perspective, no ship, no cannon, no explosion, no background stars or random floating debris. No giant halo or burst. HEAD: a compact gold-white plasma bolt, blunt diamond pulse capsule with blue titanium side rails and an amber-white central lens. TRAIL: narrow golden ion ribbon with two subtle cyan side filaments, warm bright core, tapering left. Visually a dense pulse not a missile.
